Name: Tree breeding machine
Author: Wynix233
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4]
[b] ﻿Features[/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*]﻿﻿Add a machine that breeds more tree seeds for you.
[*]Support 4 vanilla tree seeds except mushroom.
[*]Using tree seed and tree fertilizer.
[*]Each seed can produce 12-20 seeds, but mahogany produces 6-10 seeds.(Maybe I will change the amount.)
[/list]
[font=Arial][size=4]﻿ ﻿[b]How to use it?[/b][/size][/font][list]
[*]Download the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿﻿ , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991]Custom Farming Redux[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip this mod and drop them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[/list]


This is my first mod, I made it just for convenience.
I may update its texture or function later  :3
